newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.77 percent lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.77 percent lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed down by 0.77 percent in quiet trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 488.87 points, down from 492.66 on Friday.
Total volume was 1.14 million dinars against 2.51 million dinars over the previous session.
Amen Bank fell 1.5 dinar to 34 dinars.
Compagnie Internationale de Leasing CIL slid 1.5 dinar to 16.4. Coca and beer bottler SFBT was down 1.24 dinar to 86.1 dinars.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie eased 1.14 dinar to 32.8.
Retail stores Monoprix edged lower 1.06 dinar to 34.74 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF declined 0.35 dinar to 17.5.
Investment fund Tuninvest -SICAF was up 0.34 dinar to 12.2. Airline Tunis Air rose 0.1 dinar to 23.8 dinars. ($1=1.08 dinar)
